title: UI_Icon
slide_intent: Use a brief icon gesture for attention so an interface can signal activity without adding explanatory text.
strategic_value: The receiver wobble can give DB interface feedback a familiar, expressive cue.
demonstration: A dark telephone receiver wobbles and returns to rest against a pale background.
practical_value: Use the attention gesture for a momentary UI signal, rather than treating it as a change of control state.

content_islands.name: Attention gesture
content_islands.spec: Animate the centered receiver around its resting orientation.

content_islands.name: Resting state
content_islands.spec: Return it to the stable telephone silhouette.
